description: Example Amicus medicine record for Pombiliti (cipaglucosidase alfa-atga), the enzyme replacement component of the two-component Pombiliti + Opfolda regimen for adults with late-onset Pompe disease.

medicine.patientPopulation: Adults with late-onset Pompe disease (LOPD) weighing 88 lbs or more who are not improving on their current enzyme replacement therapy
medicine.mechanismOfAction: Bis-M6P-enriched ERT designed to deliver active GAA enzyme directly to muscle cells for improved binding and effective uptake
